zh: 原创潮玩角色，一只短绒圆核和一只还没拆开的竖信封长在一起：整只信封就是它的头和身体，拿掉信封就没有角色。身体是竖长矩形，顶部三角折口还贴着，它坐在自己的底边上，只有很短的圆足从底边微微露出。眯成一线的眼贴在信封中上部，几乎没有嘴，视线平平停住。不站起来，不拆封。主体是短绒，只有封口和边是一层硬挺牛皮纸。配色是牛皮纸褐配墨黑。单个角色完整全身，正面略侧，坐在浅灰纯色背景前，柔和棚拍光，像真实的搪胶毛绒或手办产品照。不要儿童绘本或涂色书风格，不要卡通吉祥物，不要闪亮的动漫大眼，不要穿衣服的人类小孩造型，不要奔跑、跳跃或任何动作场景，不要速度线，不要细长的橡皮管式手脚，不要细长的手指，不要张嘴大笑，不要多余的饰品和细节，不要背景物件。不要真人脸发型服装，不要明星姓名，不要现有潮玩或品牌名，不要疾病、伤口或残缺造型，不要整体透明果冻身体。不要拆开的信封，不要邮票贴满全身，不要文字地址，不要拆信动作。
enp: Original designer toy character: a plush rounded core fused with an unopened upright envelope — the envelope is the head and body, without it there is no character. A tall rectangle with the triangular flap still sealed, sitting on its own bottom edge, only very short round feet peeking forward. Eyes narrowed to thin lines on the upper mid section, almost no mouth, gaze level and still. Not standing, not opening the flap. Body is plush; only the flap and edges are stiff kraft paper. Colors: kraft brown with ink black. Single character, full body, slight three-quarter front view, sitting on a plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, looks like a real vinyl-plush or figure product photo. No children's book or coloring page style, no cartoon mascot, no big shiny anime eyes, no clothed human child figure, no running, jumping or action scene, no speed lines, no thin rubber-hose limbs, no thin long fingers, no wide open-mouth grin, no extra accessories or details, no background props. No real person's face, hairstyle or clothing, no celebrity names, no existing toy or brand names, no disease, wounds or disfigurement, no fully transparent jelly body. No opened envelope, no stamps all over the body, no written address, no opening motion.
